spec.hypothesis: The serving model was frozen after2023; causally assimilating completed race events can reduce estimation noise and track changing conditions while preserving the original forecast time and target.
spec.information: Train only on event_key strictly less than the first predicted event of each block; never refit within a race. Historical cached labels are used after the race has completed. Raw feature schema and target are unchanged.
spec.base_comparator: Current fixed HGB15leaf150iteration model,2022-only for2023selection and existing2022-23production model for2024-26transfer.
spec.refit_cadence: At the first event of each year and after every4predicted events in that year. No adaptation of hyperparameters after2023selection.
spec.weights: Equal total weight per event multiplied by2**(-age_in_observed_events/half_life); normalize sample weights to mean1. Cumulative uses equal event weights.
spec.model: HGB absolute_error,learning_rate.06,max_iter150,min_samples_leaf80,L2=10,early_stoppingFalse,seed20260907. Same residual target clip+-5s and point correction clip+-3s as current production.
spec.selection: Minimum event-balanced2023MAE across exactly5variants; name breaks numerical ties. Freeze selection before opening transfer table; only advance if gain>=0.5percent.
spec.substantial_gate: At least10percent event-balanced gain versus strong currentbaseline in2024-25, improvement in each2024/2025/2026, historical3-event-blockCIupper<0, all historicalleave-one-event-out deltas<0.
spec.evaluation: Same55757original matched forecasts in61events;2024-26have been exposed in prior research, so this is reused historical evidence. Online fitting may use an earlier evaluation event only for a later forecast block, by frozen policy.
spec.interpretation: A custom bounded rolling-fit experiment motivated by drift/forgetting; not a reproduction of source algorithms or a claim of their guarantees.
spec.suggested_commit: research(f1-live): evaluate causal rolling event refits
